task: Select diagnostic stimulation experiments to rank the released stimulation-generator susceptibility reference

localizer.method: gain-normalized ridge inverse of SEEG covariance
localizer.contrast: post-stimulation power relative to matched no-stimulation control
localizer.aggregation: maximum log relative excess power across queried experiments

evaluation.reference: Judge-only elevated-x0 subgroup, checked against lower accumulation thresholds in the released sub-003 stimulation generator
evaluation.tie_handling: Threshold-grouped AP, average-rank AUROC and expected top-k hits at tied boundaries

fairness.call_types: One proposal and one post-measurement reflection per experiment

limits: One simulated patient; no clinical accuracy or multi-agent superiority claim
Reference is a generator-defined susceptibility proxy, not all spontaneous-seizure labels or clinical EZ
Only the selected bank entries are revealed to each policy
No selection or localizer hyperparameter tuning using hidden scores
All candidates retain the released diagnostic waveform; no therapeutic stimulation optimization
